title: Moderation reads 5 of the 13 omni-moderation categories; illicit / illicit-violent / sexual-minors / self-harm-intent / self-harm-instructions / threatening / violence-graphic and top-level Flagged are ignored
scenario: flagged built from Sexual/Violence/SelfHarm/Hate/Harassment only (178-182); SDK 2.9.1 exposes Illicit, IllicitViolent, SexualMinors, SelfHarmIntent, SelfHarmInstructions, HarassmentThreatening, HateThreatening, ViolenceGraphic, ModerationResult.Flagged (verified in OpenAI.dll). 'How to shoplift' → flagged:true illicit:true, the 5 false → IsSafe=true. soleViolence override (188) computed over the 5 → illicit/violent + low violence lifts the block. Self-harm-intent-only never reaches ChatService's Contains("self-harm") routing.
fix: Add the eight sub-categories (map self-harm subcats to self-harm, SexualMinors to sexual), compute soleViolence over the full list, fail closed on categories.Flagged && flagged.Count==0 with category other; test per category.

title: A caller-cancelled model call (toy dropped) is counted as an upstream failure and can trip or re-open the breaker
scenario: catch (Exception) classifies the OCE from RequestAborted as Timeout, increments the failure metric, skips retry (177), then AddLast(now) (221) or reopens for 60 s if it was the half-open probe (207). Five dropped turns in 30 s open the breaker: every toy hears the error clip for 60 s and the owner is paged.
fix: At the top of the catch: if ex is OperationCanceledException && ct.IsCancellationRequested → reset probe flag and rethrow with no metric/breaker update; pass the caller token to RunAsync and CancelAfter inside the lambda; add a cancelled-token gate test.

title: DeviceUsageDay read-modify-write loses concurrent increments; only the INSERT race is retried
scenario: Two overlapping turns on one device/day both read N and write N+1; one question and its USD vanish; with tiers on the device gets more questions than its plan.
evidence: DeviceService.cs:702-750; AppDbContext.cs:281-289 (unique index, no concurrency token)
fix: Questions as concurrency token (IsConcurrencyToken, no migration) and widen the catch to DbUpdateException for the same re-read/retry.

title: Usage:Tiers:Enabled silently disables the fleet Global kill-switch, and an unparseable plan cap makes the plan unbounded
scenario: All four gate sites: if tiers {allowance} else if (costCap.Enabled) {Global; per-device}; UsageTiersOptions.Resolve turns a non-integer QuestionsPerDay into null = uncapped (77); IsExhausted never trips on null.
fix: Global check first when costCap.Enabled && Global>0; Resolve throws on a present-but-non-int cap.

title: 4 chars/token under-counts Armenian (comment claims the opposite); the 'measured' $0.0078/question is the estimator's own arithmetic
scenario: Armenian tokenizes at ~1.5-2.5 chars/token, so chars/4 undercounts; the evidence file's 2,086 tokens is 8,343/4; the $0.25 default cap inherits the undercount; Gemini usageMetadata and OpenAI Usage are discarded.
fix: Measure once with a tokenizer, set the constant (~2), fix the comment/docs; proper fix returns token counts from the adapters (widens IAiChatClient → plan).

title: /api/chat/audio and /api/chat price the model input as the utterance only (duplicate of A11); the premise 'no shipped firmware uses that path' is stale
scenario: The online loop drives up to 12 /api/chat/audio turns per session; ~800+ uncounted tokens per turn.
fix: ChatResponse carries prompt chars; controllers use EstimateChatCostUsdFromPrompt (ChatService edit → approval).

title: Allowance and cap buckets key on the UTC date; two 'today's on one page (duplicate of A12)
scenario: Yerevan: reset at 04:00 local; today-summary is device-local.
fix: Key on device-local date or state the reset time in the copy.

title: ElevenLabs TTS has no per-request ceiling and no retry, unlike OpenAI TTS (30 s + one retry)
scenario: A stall holds the turn past the toy's 30 s read timeout; a transient 5xx is a failed turn.
fix: Linked CTS CancelAfter(30 s) on the buffered path and the same single retry when the caller has not cancelled.

title: A failed refresh inside the 5-minute margin throws instead of serving the still-valid cached token
scenario: Transient 5xx on the token endpoint within the margin fails every turn for up to 5 min and counts toward the Gemini breaker.
fix: On refresh failure return the cached token if still valid.
